__comment: Latitude-based climate config for the frozen-north system. Everything north of a flat freeze line (smaller world Z) is treated as frozen latitude, fading in gradually the further north you go. This single file replaces the old latitude_spine.csv (ice/temperature spine) and the hardcoded dead-grass line constants previously baked into SeasonFoliageColorProvider, the same way LOTR Mod keeps its water_latitude.json as one settings file.

ice.__comment: freeze_line_z is a single flat world Z coordinate used for every worldX (no per-column spine anymore). South of it (larger Z, i.e. less negative) is untouched; north of it (smaller Z) the freeze effect fades in linearly from 0 to max_adjustment over fade_distance blocks (see LatitudeClimate).

dead_grass.__comment: North of a sloped line traced on the biomemap, grass gradually turns a dead yellow-brown regardless of season. The line is defined as two endpoints in biomemap pixel space (map column, row) and interpolated by map column; row 0 is the north/top edge.
